subject: Trading
title: What Legends Would Tell Beginners
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on What Legends Would Tell Beginners.

hook.text: Every legendary trader was once a beginner who lost money learning. Their advice is earned through decades of scars.

buildup.text: Buffett: 'Rule one, never lose money. Rule two, never forget rule one.' Capital preservation is the foundation.

discovery.text: Soros: 'It's not about being right. It's about how much you make when right and how little you lose when wrong.'

twist.text: Dalio: 'Pain plus reflection equals progress.' Every losing trade is a lesson—if you're honest about what went wrong.

climax.text: The universal lesson: manage risk, know yourself, stay humble, and keep learning. There are no shortcuts.

punchline.text: Every legend started with the same thing: a loss and a lesson.

quiz.question: What is the one lesson all legendary traders share?
options: Manage risk and capital preservation above all else
